description: This file defines the class DefaultConnectionMetricsCounter, which is a helper class for collecting and reporting metrics related to messaging connectivity, such as success/failure counts and measurement reporting within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: DefaultConnectionMetricsCounter
classes.description: A final class implementing ConnectionMetricsCounter to track success/failure metrics and produce measurements for connectivity-related metrics.

methods.name: recordSuccess
methods.description: Increments the success counter for the connection operation.

methods.name: recordFailure
methods.description: Increments the failure counter for the connection operation.

methods.name: getMetricType
methods.description: Returns the type of metric being tracked.

methods.name: toMeasurement
methods.description: Creates a Measurement object capturing current success/failure counts and timestamps for reporting.
